title: Recording: To Know Her Is To Love Her by John Lennon | 1973
content:
A&M Studios, Los Angeles
Producers: John Lennon, Phil Spector

John Lennon recorded a version of Phil Spector’s classic song ‘To Know Her Is To Love Her’ for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 28 November 1973.

The song was originally titled ‘To Know Him Is To Love Him’, and was first recorded by Spector’s group The Teddy Bears. Released in 1958, it became a chart-topper and was covered by a number of acts.

The Beatles had recorded their own version during their ill-fated audition for Decca on 1 January 1962, with Lennon on lead vocals. They recorded it again on 16 July 1963, for the BBC radio show Pop Go The Beatles.

‘To Know Her Is To Love Her’ remained unreleased until it was issued on the posthumous 1986 album Menlove Ave, a collection of songs recorded during the sessions for Mind Games, Walls And Bridges, and Rock ‘N’ Roll.
